message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on incoming data; CSV paths and image data are consumed directly without validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local CSV files and a local model path with no checksum verification, signed URLs, or authentication of any remote source.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is applied to the training data at any point in the shown code.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads the pretrained CheXNet model via `load_model(model_path, model_name)` and loads pretrained word embeddings without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision.

No detected label distribution validation: The code loads CSV data and creates enqueuers but performs no class balance checks, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop contains no backdoor defenses such as trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection.
No detected differential privacy: The optimizer is obtained via a plain get_optimizer call with no DP-SGD, TensorFlow Privacy, or Opacus integration anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While separate train and test CSVs are defined, there is no signing, hashing, or cryptographic isolation of evaluation data, and no evidence of multiple independent metrics or formal separation enforcement to prevent metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: There are no input shape/range checks, schema validation, or malformed-input rejection visible anywhere in the inference data-flow path; images and features are passed directly to the model.

No detected output bounds checks: The only post-processing applied to model outputs is a threshold comparison for tag predictions (`predictions >= threshold`), but there are no NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or broader output validation on generated sequences.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an image-captioning model (CNN encoder + RNN decoder), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
